title: Failure-Aware Robustness Prospective Protocol
purpose: Determine, prospectively and without reopening v0.35, what robustness claims are scientifically admissible when the learned intervention selector failed its prerequisite discrimination and activation gates.
primary_question: Can robustness of the v0.35 learned intervention mechanism be formally evaluated as an active adaptive mechanism when its prospectively required selector-discrimination and activation prerequisites were not satisfied?

design.phase_A: Read-only robustness-eligibility characterization using already-frozen v0.35 training/validation evidence and prior frozen robustness definitions only.
design.phase_B: Formal robustness evaluation remains locked unless a later prospective authorization establishes an admissible target that does not contradict the v0.35 failure boundary.

V36_Q1.name: selector_activation_eligibility
V36_Q1.evidence: Frozen v0.35 per-seed utility_probability_std and active_intervention_rate.
V36_Q1.rule: ELIGIBLE only if the already-frozen v0.35 M3 and M4 prerequisites were both SUPPORTED for every formal seed.
V36_Q1.note: This is a deterministic protocol rule, not a new threshold.

V36_Q2.name: optimization_vs_activation_decoupling
V36_Q2.evidence: Frozen per-seed selector gradient norm, selector parameter L2 movement, utility_probability_std, and active_intervention_rate.
V36_Q2.rule: Characterize whether nonzero optimization/parameter movement coexists with failed output discrimination/activation; descriptive/mechanistic characterization only.

V36_Q3.name: seed_consistency_of_failure
V36_Q3.evidence: Seeds 42,43,44 from frozen v0.35 Step9 evidence.
V36_Q3.rule: Report each seed separately; all-seed consistency may be stated only when the same frozen disposition holds for all three seeds.

V36_Q4.name: performance_activation_decoupling
V36_Q4.evidence: Frozen best-validation performance plus selector activation diagnostics from the same three v0.35 runs.
V36_Q4.rule: Describe whether classification performance can remain competitive while the learned intervention pathway remains inactive; do not interpret validation performance as robustness evidence.

V36_Q5.name: formal_robustness_admissibility
V36_Q5.rule: If V36_Q1 is INELIGIBLE, do not execute a formal robustness evaluation that attributes robustness to active learned intervention. A later protocol may authorize read-only counterfactual/failure characterization, but must not relabel inactive intervention as successful adaptive robustness.

inherited_robustness_context.use_rule: These prior condition families/hypotheses are context only in Step1. No condition-level evaluation is executed or exposed here.

aggregation_rules.seed_level: Seeds 42,43,44 remain individually reportable; cross-seed means are descriptive only.
aggregation_rules.missing_metric: Mark NOT_AVAILABLE; do not reconstruct by retraining or modified evaluation.

prohibitions: reopen or revise v0.35 scientific decisions
source or architecture modification in Step1
claiming robustness benefit from validation performance alone
claiming a sole causal mechanism from the v0.35 failure evidence
